proportion_source.reference_note: The six-view sheet is a single clean example of the same white round-can category. The source photo shows two used cans, so panel contours cannot be overlaid on the two-can silhouette. The sheet is used for lid/body/bottom topology only, never as a measured or identical-unit reference.
proportion_source.visible_structure: Two upright white plastic cans; lid with a raised outer rim and shallow recessed top; two parallel seam lines; one lift latch on each can (front can latch seen in side profile at the left edge, rear can latch facing the camera); bottom rim, centre gate and a small moulded recycling-style mark.
proportion_source.pixel_ratios: The front can is about 630 px wide and 881 px tall in the clean photo (ratio about 0.715); the rear can is partly occluded. The candidate uses diameter/height about 0.71, not a measured dimension.

layout.note: The front (screen-left) can is nearer the +X source camera and offset towards -Y. Its latch is rotated to face -Y so it is seen in side profile at the left edge, as in the photo; the rear can latch faces almost +X and is visible near the front. The reference sheet shows only one can, so the two-can arrangement follows the photo.

body.note: Solid body with a slight outward taper and rounded bottom/top edges. The body top is hidden under the lid; no internal cavity is modelled.

lid.note: Lid skirt overhangs the body; the top has a raised outer rim and a deeper shallow recessed panel with a visible step. The profile is revolved as a closed solid, so no internal cavity is modelled.

latch.note: Two-block lift latch on the lid skirt; the gap and the exact catch mechanism are hidden and inferred.

bottom_tabs.note: Two small base tabs are visible at the bottom right of the rear can; they are modelled as solid feet/catches. Stability and their real function are not verified.

bottom_gate.note: Centre injection gate on the bottom, visible in the reference bottom panel.

bottom_mark.note: Recycling-style triangular mould mark and two small letter-like bars. The exact symbol, resin code text and engraving depth are not faithfully reproduced.
